description: This file defines the interface and factory for the IMediaPipelineCapabilitiesModuleService in the Rialto media server IPC module. It includes class declarations, method signatures for client connection management, and references to external dependencies.

classes.name: IMediaPipelineCapabilitiesModuleServiceFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of IMediaPipelineCapabilitiesModuleService.

classes.name: IMediaPipelineCapabilitiesModuleService
classes.description: Interface for media pipeline capabilities module service, including client connection management.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a media pipeline capabilities module service instance, given a media pipeline service reference.
